name: caption-particle-burst
title: Particle Burst
description: Reel captions on a black rounded plate: the spoken word lights up from grey to ink; a key word marked with * in front in the words variable (e.g. *монтаж|0.48|0.90) turns red and throws a burst of sparks. All words and timings come in one variable; mount over the whole frame for the speech.
